polls.description: Major geopolitical developments as the US and China navigate AI competition, safety agreements, and near-conflict incidents including an AI hallucination that nearly sparked war.
polls.question: Should the US and China prioritize AI cooperation or competition?

cluster_stories.title: US and China Discuss Alerting Each Other to AI National Security Threats
cluster_stories.summary: Officials discussed setting up a mechanism for the two countries to notify each other of AI incidents which could threaten national security.
cluster_stories.headline: US-CHINA AGREE TO AI THREAT ALERT SYSTEM... HISTORIC DEAL

cluster_stories.title: Trump-Xi Meeting: China-US AI Rivalry Poses Questions for Summit
cluster_stories.summary: Artificial intelligence will be high on the agenda when US President Donald Trump sits down with China’s Xi Jinping at the White House on Thursday. Both superpowers see AI as the new focal point of their economic rivalry. Trump declared on Sept. 13 that “whoever wins AI, wins.”
cluster_stories.headline: TRUMP-XI SUMMIT: AI RIVALRY TAKES CENTER STAGE AT WHITE HOUSE

cluster_stories.title: Dario Amodei wants to slow AI. China isn’t taking orders
cluster_stories.summary: Chinese officials and engineers see an attempt to preserve the U.S. lead; “Why do you always get to define the game — and change the rules?”
cluster_stories.headline: CHINA REJECTS ANTHROPIC CEO'S AI SLOWDOWN PLAN... 'You Don't Make The Rules'

cluster_stories.title: The US has proposed an AI incident alert system to China
cluster_stories.summary: The United States has proposed that Washington and Beijing notify each other of AI incidents serious enough to qualify as national security events, an idea Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent put forward to Chinese officials during talks in Manhattan on Sunday. Scott Bessent and Jamieson Greer, the trade representative, met with He Lifeng, the Vice Premier, […] This story continues at The Next Web
cluster_stories.headline: US PROPOSES AI INCIDENT ALERT SYSTEM WITH CHINA

cluster_stories.title: Trump-Xi Summit Puts Global AI Race in Focus
cluster_stories.summary: Bloomberg’s Ed Ludlow breaks down what to expect from the Trump-Xi summit later this week, with AI's role anticipated to be a major part of the agenda for those upcoming talks. Plus, Bloomberg reports Paramount reached a settlement with California and other states suing to block its proposed acquisition of Warner Bros. Discovery. And, as data shows more disruption to US data centers, we get to the political debate with Democratic US Representative Suhas Subramanyam from Virginia. (Source: Bloomberg)
cluster_stories.headline: Trump-Xi Summit This Week: AI Race Takes Center Stage

cluster_stories.title: China and the US are competing for AI dominance but have shared concerns over safety
cluster_stories.summary: On Sunday, U.S. Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent said after talks in New York with Chinese Vice Premier He Lifeng ahead of the meeting between Trump and Xi that the two countries discussed the setting up of a mechanism on AI dialogue and proposed a new "notification mechanism" for AI incidents that could impact national security.
cluster_stories.headline: US-CHINA AI SAFETY TALKS... Shared Concerns Amid Dominance Race

cluster_stories.title: Xi and Trump Seek Safe AI Without Slowing the Race for Supremacy
cluster_stories.summary: Xi Jinping and Donald Trump will sit down this week to hash out a plethora of thorny issues from trade to Taiwan. One thing both sides agree on: neither can afford to tap the brakes on AI.
cluster_stories.headline: XI AND TRUMP MEET ON AI SAFETY... SUPREMACY RACE CONTINUES

cluster_stories.title: Bessent hails US-China AI dialogue ahead of Trump-Xi meeting
cluster_stories.summary: Treasury secretary says sides working towards ‘shared vision’ after talks with Chinese counterpart
cluster_stories.headline: US-CHINA AI DIALOGUE ADVANCES AHEAD OF TRUMP-XI SUMMIT

cluster_stories.title: Beijing and Washington talk about an AI hotline. But who will answer the call?
cluster_stories.summary: A hotline might prevent an AI accident from spiraling into war. But if neither the U.S. or China has a solution for "rogue AI," phoning one another about it is not going to provide much security.
cluster_stories.headline: US-CHINA AI HOTLINE PROPOSED... But Who Answers When Rogue AI Strikes?

cluster_stories.title: OpenAI cuts GPT-6 prices in half with Sol and Luna
cluster_stories.summary: They are also half the price per token, and even less per task. Sam Altman wrote that on X on Tuesday, about GPT-6 Sol and GPT-6 Luna. OpenAI released both models the same afternoon. They extend the GPT-6 family below GPT-6 Astra, which arrived on 3 September. The prices are the headline.
